title: Kanga language - Wikipedia
text: Kanga is a Nilo-Saharan language of the Kadu branch spoken in South Kordofan, Sudan. The Kufa-Lima dialect is spoken in Bilenya, Dologi, Lenyaguyox, Lima, Kilag, Kufa, Mashaish, and Toole villages, with Toole as the central village.
